scope: Three projectile class/default records, not complete collision or gameplay coverage
findings: Scattershot calls TargetingSphereAroundActor with ExcludeAroundActor true; native code adds that actor to the overlap-query exclusion list.
Two nearest-target selection passes remove each selected candidate but retain the last selected actor when no candidate replaces it.

Scattershot serializes bOnlyCollideWithLockOnActor and bDestroyWhenLockOnActorDies as true. Its native overlap handler enforces the lock-on guard, with a conditional PredCustomProjectileHitInterface exception.
With no eligible secondary targets, the selection loop has no actor and attempts no projectile spawn. This supports zero collateral projectile contribution in a truly isolated one-enemy scene.
PredProjectile inherits Actor; reflected native ancestry and TimerHandle unblock all three selected default property streams. Shared filter/effect-container schemas are also recovered.
limits: Source query/filter native semantics and collision outcomes in populated scenes remain incomplete.
Primary-target exclusion is not a guarantee that every special custom collision path is harmless.
Component defaults and native initialization still need review; property streams ending do not certify whole CDOs.
Private class bodies, member maps and native instructions are not published.
